availability.label: Availability
availability.note.available: {product} is available. It installs and runs on your own machines.
availability.note.preview: {product} has preview builds: they work, and they may change before the first release.
availability.note.in-development: {product} is in development and cannot be downloaded yet.
signup.heading: Get the release candidates
signup.lead: Leave your email and we will let you know when a release candidate of {product} is ready to try.
signup.consent: I agree to receive emails from Levix Digital Inc. about release candidates of {product}. I can withdraw my consent at any time with the unsubscribe link in every email.
signup.sender: Sent by Levix Digital Inc., Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Questions: {email}.
signup.error.consent: Tick the box to give your consent.
signup.success: Almost done: open the link in the email we just sent to confirm your subscription.
signup.rateLimited: Too many requests from your connection. Please try again in an hour.
signup.unavailable: The signup could not be sent. Please try again later, or write to {email}.
signup.noScript: The signup form needs JavaScript. You can also write to {email}.
subscription.confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
subscription.unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
subscription.confirmed: Subscription confirmed. We will email you when a release candidate of {product} is ready to try.
subscription.expired: This link is no longer valid. You can sign up again on the {product} page.
subscription.unsubscribed: You are unsubscribed. This address will receive no more emails about release candidates of {product}.
subscription.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.
subscription.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again later, or write to {email}.
